Vargul was a Engineer's Guild researcher. Vargul was baked out of his *mind*. The drugs, though not illegal, were frowned upon in Deva society, and so he had to acquire them through a black market. This had the added effect of the drugs not being 100% of what he wanted. The specific depressants he bought, in this case, had been cut with a ***very*** powerful hallucinogen.

In his drug-fueled stupor, Vargul began to see things. At first it was giant floating faces of a color he could only describe as "octarine", a sort of greenish purple. But then, oh then, his visions *changed*. The dancing orange and blue dragons cleared like a curtain, and he could see perfectly. He was looking at a billet of iron on his workbench, then his vision warped and *zoomed* in. Further and further it zoomed in. He saw tiny particles making up the iron, he saw the particles of pockets of impurities in the billet. Further and further it magnified in into a single particle until it was revealed to be a tiny galaxy. Inwards it zoomed, focusing on a planet, then a mountain, then inside a mountain, then he was seeing himself from above, then he was back at the billet.

The drug faded, but he could not get his sights out of his mind. *Tiny particles that make up everything…* He would have to look into it later. Right now, his mind was focused on the dozens of grams more of his drugs.
